Name: Italian Town Buildings
Author: Latteholn
Description:
[center][/center]
[center]        [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45720/][img]https://i.ibb.co/zhDXnsKZ/Untitled26-20260502144950.png[/img][/url][/center]
[center][color=#ffd966][font=Times New Roman][b]
[size=5]Description[/size][/b][/font][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8] A simple retexture of the vanilla town buildings, made to refresh the look of Pelican Town. This mod currently covers only the base game buildings found in town (SVE included). [/color]
[color=#cc0000]It does not include:[/color][/center]
[center][color=#cc0000][size=3]- Ginger Island buildings[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#cc0000][size=3]- Desert buildings[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#cc0000][size=3]- Festival/Temporary Events assets[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8][size=3]More retextures may be added in future updates.[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8]This mod goes well with the ff mods:[/color][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://ko-fi.com/s/f5b179e3f1]Overgrown Valley[/url][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage[/url][/color][/center]
[center]

[color=#ffd966][font=Times New Roman][size=5][b][i]Installation[/i][/b][/size][/font][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]:[/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download and extract the mod files.[/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Move the extracted files to your Mods folder.[/color][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Launch the game.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#ffd966][font=Times New Roman][size=5][i]Notes:[/i][/size][/font][/color][/b][/center]
[center][color=#f4f4f4][font=Arial]- Finally! The mod is off my wips list (for now) :3[/font][/color][/center]
[center][color=#f4f4f4][font=Arial]- Sorry for taking too long to post the mod as I have been very busy with uni. I am also posting this right before the finals season so I apologize in advance if ever I won't respond immediately :/[/font][/color][/center]
[center][font=Arial][color=#f4f4f4]- If you enjoy my work and want to see more in the future, consider buying me a coffee! I’m a student with limited free time, so any support helps me keep working on projects like this.[url=https://ko-fi.com/latteholn] Buy me a coffee here.[/url][/color][/font][/center]
